questions.stem_text:
Data in tables may also be presented in graphs. Which type of data would best be displayed
on a circle graph?

options.A: the distance of the planets from the sun
options.B: the depths of the major oceans on Earth
options.C: the amount of rainfall each day for a month
options.D: the percent of various materials in solid waste

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the percent of various materials in solid waste

questions.stem_text:
Forests have been cut and burned so that the land can be used to raise crops. Which
consequence does this activity have on the atmosphere of Earth?

options.A: It reduces the amount of carbon dioxide production.
options.B: It reduces the production of oxygen.
options.D: It decreases pollutants in the air.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It reduces the production of oxygen.

questions.stem_text:
A student wants to use a stream table to test the influence of water acidity on the
erosion rate of a stream. Which variable should be constant in this experiment?

options.A: angle of tilt of the table

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - angle of tilt of the table

questions.stem_text:
Some animals live in a grassland. A fire burns through the grassland. Which type of animal
will best compete for resources after the fire?

options.B: one that uses plants for shelter
options.C: one that lives under the ground
options.D: one that builds nests on the ground

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - one that lives under the ground
